THE RULES, ON-CHAIN

Seven days.
Five places.
Trade to record volume. Buys and sells count their ETH leg. Ties keep the earlier wallet ahead.
Each swap funds the pot. A 0.3% hook fee joins the weekly pot, alongside the separate 0.3% LP fee.
Settle when the week ends. The top five receive 40%, 25%, 15%, 10%, and 10%. No automatic payout.
